Field.Label: This plugin connects to a CyberPower UPS running the Power Panel Personal software on your local network. It authenticates via the Power Panel REST API and polls UPS status at the interval below.
Connection credentials (host, port, username, password) are configured per-device — create a new Indigo device of type "CyberPower UPS" to set them up.
Device states are discovered dynamically from live API data — new states appear automatically the first time the UPS reports a value for them (e.g. battery temperature, bypass voltage).
Poll Interval (seconds):
Field.Description: How often all UPS devices are polled. Minimum 10 seconds. 60 seconds is recommended for normal use.

Field.Label: Enable debug logging only when diagnosing a problem. Debug output includes raw API responses and every state value written — it is verbose. Disable it again once the issue is resolved.
